title: RHM Dev Update #4 Substitution!
author: FerjorPT
selftext:
Hi everyone!

After running into some issues with our **Tester01**, we decided to move forward with a new player model: **Tester03**. This was an important step: we’ve improved the realism of the passing and shooting animations and refined some equipment details.

That said, we still have a lot — a lot — of work ahead of us. We want to build a solid foundation and give RHM the time it needs. **We don’t want to release the game just for the sake of releasing it.**

We’re sharing a short video featuring some highlights from our tests: attacking moves, goals, saves, and a little surprise at the end that’s still very much a work in progress. We hope you enjoy it, and, as always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions!

![video](8qdef40tfuzh1 "New Tester03 animations")

  
RHM is an independent project developed by me, with the support of three AI assistants: **Gip (ChatGPT), Sol (Codex) and Son (Claude)**. The concept, the direction of development and the final decisions on the project are **entirely my responsibility**.
